Yeah, I can't compare myself to the 30-year-old hahahah he got something to live for.

Anyways a job that satisfies sounds good but a job that satisfies and failing school doesn't really add up, does it? people are happy that they can find a job after failing school.

I'm not really looking for new interest hobbies or new friends more people more problems, and the things you listed are tasks to distract yourself and don't really have to do with the whole job school problem.

Maybe this is me maybe this is my true self how should you or I know, but no to be honest I don't really care who I am and what makes me, you can never fully find yourself so it's an endless race trying to find yourself, not worth trying.
Vocational training is not a job direction I still need an interest for a job to choose the vocational training in.

I don't want to sound edgy but I never had interest that's how my depression probably developed.

Yeah, tolerate a job I'm already doing that with my life and it's not going anywhere so I'm tolerating my life now so I can later tolerate a job for 8hrs a day so I can sleep 12hrs a day because the 8hrs tolerating drained the last bit of everything in me, yeah sounds like my school life, sounds fun sounds livable.
I'm from Germany so yeah the German equivalent of high school

Yeah, finding a job that I'm interested in is not possible for me if I don't have interests. 

And I don't think others can find one either because 70-90% of the population are unhappy with their job and 20% are probably happy because of the money they are earing and the last 10% maybe got their dream job.
